name: sim_mutual_information_monotone_canonical
description: Canonical: I(A;B)>=0 always (z3+cvc5+pytorch); I_c<=I(A;B) always; I(A;B)=2*S(A) for pure states; boundary Bell and product state checks. Step 6 bridge prerequisites established.

pytorch.reason: Load-bearing: random density matrix generation via Ginibre ensemble, partial trace via einsum, von Neumann entropy via eigvalsh, Schmidt decomposition for pure state identity I(A;B)=2*S(A), Bell state boundary checks.

pyg.reason: no graph learning required; probe operates on density matrices not graph structures

z3.reason: Load-bearing: P3 UNSAT proof that I(A;B)<0 is structurally impossible (strong subadditivity axiom encoded as linear constraint); N1 UNSAT proof that I_c > I(A;B) forces S(B)<0 which contradicts S(B)>=0.

cvc5.reason: Load-bearing: N2 independent cross-check of I(A;B)>=0 via strong subadditivity in QF_LRA logic, confirming z3 result with separate solver.

sympy.reason: Load-bearing: symbolic derivation of I(A;B) = I_c + S(B) relation, and pure-state identity I(A;B) = 2*S(A) when S(AB)=0.

clifford.reason: no Clifford rotor or geometric algebra computation required in this probe

geomstats.reason: no Riemannian manifold computation required; geometry handled analytically

e3nn.reason: no SO(3)-equivariant neural network computation required in this probe

rustworkx.reason: no graph traversal or path computation required in this probe

xgi.reason: no hypergraph structure required; probe uses standard matrix operations

toponetx.reason: no chain complex or cell complex computation required in this probe

gudhi.reason: no persistent homology or Rips complex computation required in this probe

P1_MI_nonnegative_random_sweep.note: I(A;B) = S(A)+S(B)-S(AB) >= 0 for 20 random 4x4 density matrices

P2_pure_state_MI_equals_2SA.note: For pure |psi>_AB: S(AB)=0 and I(A;B)=2*S(A) via Schmidt symmetry

P3_z3_MI_negative_impossible.note: UNSAT: I(A;B)<0 requires S(AB)>S(A)+S(B), which contradicts subadditivity S(A)+S(B)>=S(AB)

N1_z3_Ic_gt_MI_impossible.note: UNSAT: I_c > I(A;B) requires S(B)<0, which contradicts entropy non-negativity S(B)>=0. Since I(A;B) = I_c + S(B) and S(B)>=0, I_c <= I(A;B) always.

N2_cvc5_MI_nonnegative_crosscheck.note: cvc5 UNSAT: cross-check confirms I(A;B)<0 impossible via subadditivity

B1_product_state_MI_zero.note: Product state: I(A;B)=0, I_c=-S(B)<0 (no coherent info to transmit)

B3_sympy_decomposition_identity.note: sympy: I(A;B)=I_c+S(B) confirmed; pure state I(A;B)=2*S(A) confirmed
